title: Mechanical joints.
officialText:
Mechanical joints on drainage pipes shall be made with an elastomeric seal conforming to ASTM C
1173, ASTM D 3212 or CAN/CSA B602. Mechanical joints shall be installed only in underground systems unless otherwise
approved. Joints shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and in conformance with acceptance criteria
established by the commissioner.
